replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
The map is aesthetically outstanding but I have few issues of how it might play out.

  • The lack of void gap means it will be rushed very easily 
  • Also I feel tunneling would be too easy due to the lack of the gap.
  • Wall running would be very easy as is on maps with no void gap
  • Im not sure but U-Bridging might also be an issue
